method: One direct FX WRITE per probe, two separate complete stable fresh DEVICE dumps, both partner FX values restored, full-state comparison, 24-second watch, final dump and END ACK.
scope: Warm linked pairs; small steps on every input/output channel, -30/0 dB via input 13 and output 1. No cold-start, mono, whole-domain, long-term or acoustic-safety qualification.
